verdict.rationale: Morph exposes an OpenAI-compatible REST API at api.morphllm.com/v1 with extensive docs (introduction, endpoints, quickstart, SDK component references) and even an Anthropic Messages-compatible endpoint, and a community member confirms driving it programmatically via a third-party CLI tool. Missing for 10: a formal machine-readable OpenAPI/swagger spec (probe found only 404s) and broader independent API-driven integrations beyond one HN example.
